evidence:
Frozen task/task.toml:26-38 sets environment_mode="separate" and the exact required five-variable verifier.env block, byte-equal to frozen template/task.toml. Public verifier network is correct; the older internal annotation mentioning an allowlist is superseded by the current quality row and skill. Frozen task/tests/Dockerfile:1-2,16-21,31 is byte-identical to the frozen template and uses its version-tagged Node/Python bases, exact npm versions and harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7. All five judge tables retain judge="claude-code" at line 2 and contain no model, reasoning-effort, temperature or judge weight override.
Adversarial source checks: an app trying to inherit the provider token is launched with env -i and an explicit noncredential environment as uid 65534 (tests/test.sh:104-111 and 160-167); a conforming app using public off-origin assets is not rejected by a hidden allowlist. The task introduces no wiring difference that would let a broken submission choose another judge model or deny a conforming submission the configured provider. These are source checks, not executed attack claims.
Supplementary installed-parser evidence resolves all five dimensions to claude-code/z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx. All 15 inspection-record source hashes match frozen tests. The inspection driver explicitly sets the expected model variables and substitutes /usr/bin/true for provider launch, so it supports parser resolution only; this Pass is for row 10 wiring and does not waive separate required full configured grading or credential-authentication measurements.
